title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Meeting Yields No Answers
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau led a 90-minute LIV Golf players-only meeting at Trump Bedminster, but no concrete updates on the league's future or funding were provided amid uncertainty about its survival beyond 2026.

items.headline: Schauffele Enters Top 10 Money List
items.text: Xander Schauffele moved up to No. 9 on the PGA Tour career money list, joining Tiger Woods, Rory McIlroy, and Scottie Scheffler as players with over $100 million in career earnings.
